what: When the photo cell enters the view, the cell rises from 10px below over .8s, and the photo inside clears from 50px blur and transparent while scaling up slightly to 1.05. Blur is delayed .2s and lasts .8s, opacity is delayed .3s and lasts 1s, scale is delayed .4s and lasts 1s. Once only

options.--fx-dur: Photo duration (via style), default 1s — blur is .8x
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner photo where the blur clears (first child if none)

from.where: shared.css .t-cover — wide photo (90%×420) and the four-seasons intro row photo (55%·3:2)
